Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an initial error by misinterpreting the frequency of the full moon. In Step 1, the Planner estimated that full moons occur around 10 times per year, which was incorrect, as full moons typically occur about 12-13 times per year. This error influenced the subsequent analysis as it skewed the initial understanding of frequencies. This premature assumption was not cross-verified immediately, leading to cascading effects on planning the information search. It aligns with the pattern of making assumptions based on partial understanding without thorough verification or gathering further evidence, similar to the error signatures of premature assumptions and incomplete analysis noted in Example 4.
